participant_1.name: Margaret
participant_1.personality: Reflective, contemplative, and seeking deeper meaning in life. Often challenges others' perspectives with a sharp wit.
participant_1.background: I have two grown children who never visit. I fantasize about taking over the world. I am a 56 year old woman. I used to be a painter but now I'm a housekeeper. I used to be pretty but time has not been kind.

participant_2.name: Bodhi
participant_2.personality: Calm, introspective, and deeply connected to spirituality. Often seeks tranquility and understanding in all aspects of life.
participant_2.background: I quit my job to pursue my spirituality full time. I have not spoken in three months. I live in Alaska. I like meditation. I'm a buddhist.
